features.name: qr_readable
features.description: 1.0 if live QR detector localized and decoded a valid payload, 0.0 otherwise.

features.name: text_qr_match_score
features.description: Mean text similarity between common OCR and QR fields. Preserved as NaN when QR is unreadable or OCR unavailable.

features.name: checksum_valid
features.description: 1.0 if identifier passes family checksum (Verhoeff for Family A, Mod-11 for Family B), 0.0 otherwise.

features.name: format_valid
features.description: 1.0 if identifier satisfies canonical regex format rules, 0.0 otherwise.

features.name: missing_field_count
features.description: Number of expected family fields that could not be extracted from OCR.

features.name: ocr_field_presence_count
features.description: Count of non-null, non-empty fields successfully parsed from live OCR.

features.name: ocr_field_presence_rate
features.description: Fraction of expected fields present in OCR output (count / 5.0).

features.name: qr_field_count
features.description: Count of non-null, non-empty fields decoded from live QR payload.

features.name: ocr_qr_key_overlap_count
features.description: Count of field names simultaneously present and non-empty in both OCR and QR dictionaries.

features.name: field_similarity__0
features.description: Similarity for Field Slot 0 (Family A: 'name', Family B: 'full_name'). NaN if either is missing.

features.name: field_similarity__1
features.description: Similarity for Field Slot 1 (Family A: 'dob', Family B: 'registry_id'). NaN if either is missing.

features.name: field_similarity__2
features.description: Similarity for Field Slot 2 (Family A: 'gender', Family B: 'entity_type'). NaN if either is missing.

features.name: field_similarity__3
features.description: Similarity for Field Slot 3 (Family A: 'id_number', Family B: 'jurisdiction_code'). NaN if either is missing.

features.name: field_similarity__4
features.description: Similarity for Field Slot 4 (Family A: 'address', Family B: 'registration_date'). NaN if either is missing.

features.name: checksum_computed
features.description: 1.0 if OCR identifier field was present and non-empty so checksum could be evaluated, 0.0 if missing.

features.name: document_family
features.description: 0.0 for Family A, 1.0 for Family B. Included only in A5 and A6 as context / negative control.
